cover.headline: 12 stories in 5 minutes. Israel's vote is deadlocked, Russia hits Kyiv's South Bridge, the Fed decides.

stories.head: Israel's election ends in a deadlock
body: Exit polls give Eisenkot's bloc 52-53 seats and Netanyahu's about 50. A majority needs 61. Turnout was a record.
US: Trump says he will accept the midterms "if they're honest." The DOJ is pressing states over voter rolls.

stories.head: Russia hits Kyiv's South Bridge
body: Officials say 16 ballistic missiles and over 280 drones hit Kyiv overnight. Finland and Norway's leaders phoned Putin.
A Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted more Houthi launches. Jordan struck southern Syria after the Karak church attack.

stories.head: Fed expected to hold as inflation hits 3.7%
body: Rates are expected to stay at 3.75-4%. Markets see a 73% chance of a hike on Dec. 8-9, per Euronews.
Boeing fell nearly 10%. SK Hynix reported record profit. IMF staff cleared a $900m Argentina tranche.
stories.sources: Sources: Euronews, The Standard, SBS, ANSA

stories.head: Flavio Bolsonaro reportedly leaves Brazil
body: He lost the runoff by over 4.4 million votes. Brazil's court had ordered him to surrender his passport. He denies wrongdoing.
The US says it will grant visas. The departure is reported, not confirmed.

stories.head: Egypt shuts Mada Masr, UK charges two
body: A Cairo court ordered independent outlet Mada Masr closed. Its editor was fined about $53,400 for having no license.
UK prosecutors charged two men over RAF Fairford. Police believe a foreign intelligence service, Iran's, was assisted.
